---
id: common-raven
title: Common raven
---
The common raven (*Corvus corax*) is a large corvid of the Holarctic.
Pairs hold a territory through the year. They cache meat, drop nuts on
hard ground, and sometimes play in wind. Vocal repertoires are large;
local call variants spread culturally. Body size exceeds that of a crow;
the tail is wedge-shaped in flight.
